common.tagline: Proactive, compassionate credit resolution under RBI guidelines
common.privacyNotice: We will never ask for your OTP, PIN or CVV.

landing.title: Pre-NPA Rescue Demo Portal
landing.subtitle: Early financial stress detection, uplift targeting, compassionate resolution & automated compliance.
landing.instructions: Select an interactive demo persona to explore the end-to-end system:

priya.title: Customer — Priya (CUST-DEMO-PRIYA)
priya.desc: Salary stopped for 3 months, paying min-due only. Early warning detects stress. Recommended for a fee waiver + 6-month EMI plan.

ravi.title: Customer — Ravi (CUST-DEMO-RAVI)
ravi.desc: Lost job, supporting family, cannot afford payments. Bot detects zero capacity, ceases debt pressure, checks insurance, and schedules a human hardship officer.

collector.title: Collections Officer (collector1)
collector.desc: Prioritised queue sorted by uplift potential. Clear explainability reason codes and compliance guard preventing illegal out-of-hours calls.

hardship.title: Hardship Officer (officer1)
hardship.desc: Review distress referrals, manage compassionate callbacks, and approve restructured relief plans requiring senior discretion.

admin.title: Policy Administrator (admin1)
admin.desc: Inspect board-approved policy parameters (waiver limits, EMI caps). AI offers strictly originate from this configuration.

auditor.title: Compliance Auditor (auditor1)
auditor.desc: Audit automated red-team test results, bias swap equivalence, prompt injection defenses, and compliance mapping matrix.
